title: Differential livelihood impacts of eucalypt and pine plantations on state-owned land
Guiding private afforestation to raise public goods provision: Understanding farmers' multi-dimensional preferences for trees in India
The importance of distinguishing between natural and managed tree cover gains in the moist tropics
A mix of reforestation methods offers more cost-effective climate mitigation
Bringing the forest back: Restoration priorities in Colombia
abstract:
Colombia has committed to ambitious forest restoration targets which include a 1 million ha Bonn Challenge commitment and 6.47–8.31 million ha (rehabilitation and restoration, respectively) under the National Restoration Plan. Determining where and how to implement programs to achieve these targets remains a significant challenge.
Colombia.
We adopt a multi‐objective optimisation framework for restoration planning and apply it to Colombia. We explore cost‐effective solutions that leverage the potential for assisted natural regeneration benefits while accounting for opportunity and establishment costs of restoration and maximising biodiversity conservation and climate change mitigation benefits. We explore four politically relevant restoration area‐based targets (1, 6, 6.47 and 8.31 million ha) and identify minimum cost, and suites of maximum benefit and cost‐effective solutions.
We identify solutions that simultaneously perform well across biodiversity and carbon objectives, despite trade‐offs between these objectives. We find that cost‐effective solutions can achieve on average 91.1%, 90.8%, 90.5% and 90.1% of maximum carbon benefit and 100% of the maximum biodiversity benefit while significantly reducing costs. On average, the cost‐effective solutions reduce the cost by 87.5%, 56.8%, 59.6% and 46.2% compared to the maximum benefit solutions considering one, six, 6.47 and 8.31 million ha restoration targets, respectively.
Colombia has committed to bold restoration and conservation targets, such as those under the new 2030 Convention on Biological Diversity Global Biodiversity Framework. Strategic forest restoration planning will play an important role in achieving Colombia's biodiversity conservation and climate mitigation goals. We provide quantitative evidence to inform planning for environmentally and economically sensible restoration policy and practice in the country. Our framework and results can help guide Colombia towards meeting its ambitious forest restoration targets cost‐effectively.
abstract_zh:
哥伦比亚已承诺实现雄心勃勃的森林恢复目标，包括100万公顷的“波恩挑战”（Bonn Challenge）承诺，以及根据《国家恢复计划》分别设定的647万至831万公顷目标（分别对应恢复（rehabilitation）和修复（restoration））。确定在何处以及如何实施项目以实现这些目标，仍是一项重大挑战。
哥伦比亚。
我们采用多目标优化框架进行恢复规划，并将其应用于哥伦比亚。我们探索兼具成本效益的方案，充分利用辅助性自然再生的潜力，同时考虑恢复的机会成本和建植成本，并使生物多样性保护与气候变化减缓效益最大化。我们考察了四个具有政治意义的面积目标（100万、600万、647万和831万公顷），并确定了最低成本方案、最大效益方案组合以及具有成本效益的方案。
我们发现，部分兼具成本效益的方案能够在生物多样性与碳目标上同时表现良好，尽管两者之间存在权衡。我们发现，在上述四个恢复目标下，兼具成本效益的方案平均可实现最大碳效益的91.1%、90.8%、90.5%和90.1%，并实现最大生物多样性效益的100%，同时显著降低成本。与最大效益方案相比，考虑100万、600万、647万和831万公顷恢复目标时，成本效益方案平均分别降低87.5%、56.8%、59.6%和46.2%的成本。
哥伦比亚已承诺实现大胆的恢复与保护目标，例如《生物多样性公约》新的2030年全球生物多样性框架下的目标。战略性森林恢复规划将在实现哥伦比亚的生物多样性保护和气候减缓目标中发挥重要作用。我们提供定量证据，为该国在环境和经济上合理的恢复政策与实践规划提供参考。我们的框架和结果有助于指导哥伦比亚以具有成本效益的方式实现其雄心勃勃的森林恢复目标。

title: Cost-effectiveness of natural forest regeneration and plantations for climate mitigation
abstract:
Mitigating climate change cost-effectively requires identifying least-cost-per-ton GHG abatement methods. Here, we estimate and map GHG abatement cost (US$ per tCO
2
) for two common reforestation methods: natural regeneration and plantations. We do so by producing and integrating new maps of implementation costs and opportunity costs of reforestation, likely plantation genus and carbon accumulation by means of natural regeneration and plantations, accounting for storage in harvested wood products. We find natural regeneration (46%) and plantations (54%) would each have lower abatement cost across about half the area considered suitable for reforestation of 138 low- and middle-income countries. Using the more cost-effective method at each location, the 30 year, time-discounted abatement potential of reforestation below US$50 per tCO
2
is 31.4 GtCO
2
(24.2–34.3 GtCO
2
below US$20–100 per tCO
2
)—44% more than natural regeneration alone or 39% more than plantations alone. We find that reforestation offers 10.3 (2.8) times more abatement below US$20 per tCO
2
(US$50 per tCO
2
) than the most recent IPCC estimate.
abstract_zh: 以最低的单位成本实现减排，是经济高效地减缓气候变化的关键，这要求识别每吨温室气体减排成本最低的方法。本文估算并绘制了两种常见造林方式——自然再生和人工林——每吨CO2的减排成本（美元/吨CO2）。我们通过整合新绘制的造林实施成本与机会成本地图、可能的人工林树种、自然再生和人工林的碳积累情况（包括收获木制品中的碳储存）来完成这一估算。我们发现，在138个中低收入国家适宜造林的区域中，自然再生（46%）和人工林（54%）各自在约一半的区域具有较低的减排成本。在每个地点采用成本更低的方式，每吨CO2低于50美元的30年、经时间折现的造林减排潜力为31.4 GtCO2（每吨CO2 20–100美元时为24.2–34.3 GtCO2）——比单独采用自然再生多44%，或比单独采用人工林多39%。我们发现，在每吨CO2 20美元以下（50美元以下）时，造林提供的减排量分别是IPCC最新估计值的10.3倍（2.8倍）。

title: People today who plant trees successfully do it for livelihoods and income not for biodiversity or climate mitigation
venue: Frontiers in Forests and Global Change

title: Inferring Economic Impacts from a Program's Physical Outcomes: An Application to Forest Protection in Thailand
abstract: Economists typically estimate the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) when evaluating government programs. The economic interpretation of the ATT can be ambiguous when program outcomes are measured in purely physical terms, as they often are in evaluations of environmental programs (e.g., avoided deforestation). This paper presents an approach for inferring economic impacts from physical outcomes when the ATT is estimated using propensity-score matching. For the case of forest protection, we show that a protection program’s ex post economic impact, as perceived by the government agency responsible for protection decisions, can be proxied by a weighted ATT, with the weights derived from the propensity of being treated (i.e., protected). We apply this new metric to mangrove protection in Thailand during 1987–2000. We find that the government’s protection program avoided the loss of 12.8% of the economic value associated with the protected mangrove area. This estimate is about a quarter smaller than the conventional ATT for avoided deforestation, 17.3 percentage points. The difference between the two measures indicates that the program tended to be less effective at reducing deforestation in locations where the government perceived the net benefits of protection as being greater, which is the opposite of the relationship that would characterize a maximally effective program.
abstract_zh: 经济学家在评估政府项目时，通常估计处理组平均处理效应（ATT）。当项目成果仅以纯物理指标衡量时（这在环境项目评估中很常见，例如避免的森林砍伐），ATT的经济学解释可能含糊不清。本文提出一种方法，在使用倾向得分匹配估计ATT时，从物理成果推断经济影响。以森林保护为例，我们表明，负责保护决策的政府机构所感知的保护项目事后经济影响，可以用加权ATT来近似，其权重取自被处理（即受保护）的倾向得分。我们将这一新指标应用于1987–2000年泰国的红树林保护。我们发现，政府的保护项目避免了受保护红树林面积所对应经济价值12.8%的损失。这一估计值比传统的避免森林砍伐ATT（17.3个百分点）小约四分之一。两种度量之间的差异表明，在政府认为保护净收益较大的地区，该项目减少砍伐的效果往往较差，这与最大有效项目应具有的关系恰好相反。

title: Response diversity as a sustainability strategy
Redefining "abandoned" agricultural land in the context of reforestation
venue: Frontiers in Forests and Global Change
abstract: Global mapping efforts to date have relied on vague and oversimplified definitions of “abandoned” agricultural land which results in overestimates of the land area that is likely to support persistent increases in forest cover and associated carbon sequestration. We propose a new conceptualization of abandoned agricultural land that incorporates changes in landholding status over time into determining whether land should be considered as abandoned. In order to develop more realistic estimates of the amount of land available for reforestation, we recommend clearly defining how abandoned land is categorized, discerning who owns and has rights to use the land, and combining remotely sensed data with household/stakeholder surveys to understand landowner motivations for not cropping or grazing land.
abstract_zh: 迄今为止的全球制图工作依赖于对“废弃”农业用地含糊且过度简化的定义，这导致对那些可能持续增加森林覆盖并带来相应碳封存的土地面积的高估。我们提出一种关于废弃农业用地的新概念，将土地持有状况随时间的变化纳入判定土地是否应被视为废弃的标准。为了更切实地估计可用于造林的土地面积，我们建议：明确界定废弃土地的分类方式，辨别谁拥有土地及其使用权，并将遥感数据与住户/利益相关者调查相结合，以了解土地所有者不进行耕种或放牧的动机。

title: Scaling smallholder tree cover restoration across the tropics
Is the Distribution of Ecosystem Service Benefits Pro-Poor? Evidence from Water Purification by Forests in Thailand
abstract: Forests are widely believed to provide a water purification service that reduces the cost of treating drinking water, but few empirical economic studies have investigated this service in developing countries, where deforestation rates and thus threats to the service tend to be higher than in developed countries. Even fewer studies have investigated the distribution of the benefits of this service, or any other regulating ecosystem service for that matter, in either developing or developed countries. Using quarterly panel data for 158 water utilities in Thailand during 2004–2014, we find robust evidence that forests significantly reduced the material cost of water treatment, but we find no evidence that the cost reductions were progressive in the sense of being larger in provinces with higher poverty rates. The economic justification for source water protection in Thailand appears to hinge purely on considerations of efficiency — does source water protection provide net benefits? — not on the distribution of those benefits between poorer and richer locations. Research in other countries is needed to determine if the absence of pro-poor distributional impacts of forest water purification is unique to Thailand or the norm and if interventions that enhance forest water purification significantly reduce poverty in locations served by treated drinking water systems.
abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为森林提供水质净化服务，可降低饮用水的处理成本，但在发展中国家，很少有实证经济研究考察这一服务，而这些国家的森林砍伐率及由此对该服务的威胁往往高于发达国家。更少的研究考察这一服务——或任何其他调节性生态系统服务——的效益分配情况，无论是在发展中国家还是发达国家。利用泰国158家自来水公司2004–2014年的季度面板数据，我们发现了稳健的证据，表明森林显著降低了水处理的物质成本，但没有证据表明这些成本降低具有累进性，即在贫困率较高的省份成本降幅更大。泰国水源保护的经济合理性似乎完全取决于效率方面的考量——水源保护是否带来净效益？——而非这些效益在较贫穷与较富裕地区之间的分配。需要其他国家的研究来确定，森林水质净化对穷人影响的缺失究竟是泰国特有的现象还是普遍规律，以及增强森林水质净化的干预措施能否显著减少由经处理饮用水系统供水地区的贫困。

title: Conservation, biodiversity and infectious disease: scientific evidence and policy implications
venue: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B

title: Ecosystem change and human health: implementation economics and policy
venue: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B
abstract:
Several recent initiatives such as
Planetary Health
,
EcoHealth
and
One Health
claim that human health depends on flourishing natural ecosystems. However, little has been said about the operational and implementation challenges of health-oriented conservation actions on the ground. We contend that ecological–epidemiological research must be complemented by a form of implementation science that examines: (i) the links between specific conservation actions and the resulting ecological changes, and (ii) how this ecological change impacts human health and well-being, when human behaviours are considered. Drawing on the policy evaluation tradition in public economics, first, we present three examples of recent social science research on conservation interventions that affect human health. These examples are from low- and middle-income countries in the tropics and subtropics. Second, drawing on these examples, we present three propositions related to impact evaluation and non-market valuation that can help guide future multidisciplinary research on conservation and human health. Research guided by these propositions will allow stakeholders to determine how ecosystem-mediated strategies for health promotion compare with more conventional biomedical prevention and treatment strategies for safeguarding health.
This article is part of the themed issue ‘Conservation, biodiversity and infectious disease: scientific evidence and policy implications’.
abstract_zh:
近期若干倡议，如“行星健康”（Planetary Health）、“生态健康”（EcoHealth）和“同一健康”（One Health），都主张人类健康依赖于繁茂的自然生态系统。然而，关于以健康为导向的保护行动在实地的运营和实施挑战，人们却鲜有论述。我们认为，生态—流行病学研究必须辅之以一种实施科学，该科学应考察：（i）特定保护行动与由此产生的生态变化之间的联系，以及（ii）在考虑人类行为的情况下，这种生态变化如何影响人类健康和福祉。借鉴公共经济学中的政策评估传统，我们首先介绍了三个近期关于影响人类健康的保护干预的社会科学研究案例，这些案例来自热带和亚热带的低收入和中等收入国家。其次，基于这些案例，我们提出了三项与影响评估和非市场价值评估有关的命题，以帮助指导未来关于保护与人类健康的多学科研究。遵循这些命题开展的研究将使利益相关方能够判断，以生态系统为媒介的健康促进策略与传统的生物医学预防和治疗策略相比，如何用于保障健康。
本文是主题专刊“保护、生物多样性与传染病：科学证据与政策含义”的一部分。

title: Using the Delphi method to value protection of the Amazon rainforest
Econometric Evidence on Forest Ecosystem Services: Deforestation and Flooding in Malaysia
abstract: Governments around the world are increasingly invoking hydrological services, such as flood mitigation and water purification, as a justification for forest conservation programs in upstream areas. Yet, rigorous empirical evidence that these programs are actually delivering the intended services remains scant. We investigate the effect of deforestation on flood-mitigation services in Peninsular Malaysia during 1984–2000, a period when detailed data on both flood events and land-use change are available for 31 river basins. Floods are the most common natural disaster in tropical regions, but the ability of tropical forests to mitigate large-scale floods associated with heavy rainfall events remains disputed. We find that the conversion of inland tropical forests to oil palm and rubber plantations significantly increased the number of days flooded during the wettest months of the year. Our results demonstrate the importance of using disaggregated land-use data, controlling for potentially confounding factors, and applying appropriate estimators in econometric studies on forest ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 世界各国政府日益以水文服务（如洪水缓解和水净化）作为上游地区森林保护项目的理由。然而，这些项目是否真正提供了预期服务，严格的实证证据仍然稀缺。我们考察了1984至2000年间马来西亚半岛森林砍伐对洪水缓解服务的影响，这一时期，31个流域的洪水事件和土地利用变化数据都有详细记录。洪水是热带地区最常见的自然灾害，但热带森林缓解与强降雨相关的大规模洪水的能力，仍存在争议。我们发现，内陆热带森林转为油棕和橡胶种植园，显著增加了一年中最湿润月份的洪涝天数。我们的结果表明，在关于森林生态系统服务的计量经济学研究中，使用分类细化的土地利用数据、控制潜在的混杂因素并采用恰当的估计量都十分重要。

title: Impact Evaluation of Forest Conservation Programs: Benefit-Cost Analysis, Without the Economics
Valuing Water Purification by Forests: An Analysis of Malaysian Panel Data
abstract: Water purification might be the most frequently invoked example of an economically valuable ecosystem service, yet the impacts of upstream land use on downstream municipal water treatment costs remain poorly understood. This is especially true in developing countries, where rates of deforestation are highest and cost-effective expansion of safe water supplies is needed the most. We present the first econometric study to estimate directly the effect of tropical forests on water treatment cost. We exploit a rich panel dataset from Malaysia, which enables us to control for a wide range of potentially confounding factors. We find significant, robust evidence that protecting both virgin and logged forests against conversion to nonforest land uses reduced water treatment costs, with protection of virgin forests reducing costs more. The marginal value of this water purification service varied greatly across treatment plants, thus implying that the service offered a stronger rationale for forest protection in some locations than others. On average, the service value was large relative to treatment plants’ expenditures on priced inputs, but it was very small compared to producer surpluses for competing land uses. For various reasons, however, the latter comparison exaggerates the shortfall between the benefits and the costs of enhancing water purification by protecting forests. Moreover, forest protection decisions that appear to be economically unjustified when only water purification is considered might be justified when a broader range of services is taken into account.
abstract_zh: 水净化可能是经济上有价值的生态系统服务中最常被援引的例子，然而，上游土地利用对下游市政水处理成本的影响仍然知之甚少。在森林砍伐率最高、而安全饮用水供给的成本效益扩展最为迫切的发展中国家，情况尤其如此。我们提出了首个直接估计热带森林对水处理成本影响的计量经济学研究。我们利用马来西亚一个丰富的面板数据集，从而能够控制广泛的潜在混杂因素。我们发现有显著且稳健的证据表明，保护原始森林和采伐后森林免于转为非森林用地，降低了水处理成本，其中保护原始森林的成本降低幅度更大。这一水净化服务的边际价值在不同水处理厂之间差异很大，因此表明，该服务在某些地点比在其他地点更有理由支持森林保护。平均而言，该服务的价值相对于水处理厂在计价投入品上的支出而言较大，但与竞争性土地用途的生产者剩余相比则非常小。然而，由于种种原因，后一比较夸大了通过保护森林来增强水净化的收益与成本之间的差距。此外，仅考虑水净化时看似经济上不合理的森林保护决策，在考虑更广泛服务时可能是合理的。

title: Creation of Malaysia's Royal Belum State Park: A Case Study of Conservation in a Developing Country
abstract: The incentives for resource extraction and development make the conservation of biodiversity challenging within tropical forestlands. The 2007 establishment of the Royal Belum State Park in the Malaysian state of Perak offers lessons for creating protected areas in tropical countries where subnational governments are major forestland owners. This article elucidates the social and political forces that influenced Royal Belum’s creation. Those forces included Malaysian conservation groups’ efforts to establish the ecological uniqueness of the site and rally public support to protect it; the Perak state government, which is the landowner under Malaysia’s constitution, seeking a protection option that would minimize the economic costs to it (and perhaps generate net economic benefits); and the federal government providing a legal framework and support for park protection and ecotourism development. Successful long-run protection of Royal Belum will require action beyond simply designating the area as protected.
abstract_zh: 资源开采和开发的激励使热带林地的生物多样性保护颇具挑战。2007年在马来西亚霹雳州设立的皇家贝鲁州立公园，为在次国家政府是主要林地所有者的热带国家建立保护区提供了经验。本文阐明了影响皇家贝鲁公园设立的社会和政治力量。这些力量包括：马来西亚保护团体为确立该地的生态独特性并动员公众支持而作出的努力；霹雳州政府（根据马来西亚宪法，该州是土地所有者）寻求一种能将其经济成本降至最低（或许还能产生净经济收益）的保护方案；以及联邦政府为公园保护和生态旅游开发提供的法律框架和支持。要实现皇家贝鲁的长期成功保护，还需要采取仅将该地区划定为保护区之外的行动。

title: Global economic consequences of selected surgical diseases: a modelling study
Incorporating local visitor valuation information into the design of new recreation sites in tropical forests
Reconciling oil palm expansion and climate change mitigation in Kalimantan, Indonesia
abstract: Our society faces the pressing challenge of increasing agricultural production while minimizing negative consequences on ecosystems and the global climate. Indonesia, which has pledged to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from deforestation while doubling production of several major agricultural commodities, exemplifies this challenge. Here we focus on palm oil, the world's most abundant vegetable oil and a commodity that has contributed significantly to Indonesia's economy. Most oil palm expansion in the country has occurred at the expense of forests, resulting in significant GHG emissions. We examine the extent to which land management policies can resolve the apparently conflicting goals of oil palm expansion and GHG mitigation in Kalimantan, a major oil palm growing region of Indonesia. Using a logistic regression model to predict the locations of new oil palm between 2010 and 2020 we evaluate the impacts of six alternative policy scenarios on future emissions. We estimate net emissions of 128.4-211.4 MtCO2 yr(-1) under business as usual expansion of oil palm plantations. The impact of diverting new plantations to low carbon stock land depends on the design of the policy. We estimate that emissions can be reduced by 9-10% by extending the current moratorium on new concessions in primary forests and peat lands, 35% by limiting expansion on all peat and forestlands, 46% by limiting expansion to areas with moderate carbon stocks, and 55-60% by limiting expansion to areas with low carbon stocks. Our results suggest that these policies would reduce oil palm profits only moderately but would vary greatly in terms of cost-effectiveness of emissions reductions. We conclude that a carefully designed and implemented oil palm expansion plan can contribute significantly towards Indonesia's national emissions mitigation goal, while allowing oil palm area to double.
abstract_zh: 我们的社会面临着一项紧迫挑战：在提高农业产量的同时，尽量减少对生态系统和全球气候的负面影响。印度尼西亚承诺减少因森林砍伐造成的温室气体（GHG）排放，同时将多种主要农产品产量翻番，它正是这一挑战的典型例子。本文聚焦棕榈油——世界上产量最大的植物油，也是为印尼经济做出重要贡献的商品。该国大部分油棕扩张是以牺牲森林为代价的，导致了大量温室气体排放。我们考察了土地管理政策在多大程度上能够调和油棕扩张与温室气体减排这两个看似冲突的目标，研究地点为印尼主要油棕产区加里曼丹（Kalimantan）。我们使用Logistic回归模型预测2010至2020年间新增油棕种植的位置，并评估六种替代政策情景对未来排放的影响。我们估计，若按照一切照旧的扩张方式，油棕种植园的净排放量为每年128.4–211.4 MtCO2。将新种植园转移至低碳储量土地的影响取决于政策的设计。我们估计，通过延长现行的原始森林和泥炭地新特许经营许可暂停令，排放可减少9–10%；通过限制在所有泥炭地和林地上的扩张，排放可减少35%；通过将扩张限制在中等碳储量区域，排放可减少46%；通过将扩张限制在低碳储量区域，排放可减少55–60%。我们的结果表明，这些政策只会适度降低油棕利润，但在减排的成本效益方面差异很大。我们的结论是，精心设计和实施的油棕扩张规划可以为印尼的国家减排目标做出重要贡献，同时允许油棕种植面积翻番。

title: Tropical countries may be willing to pay more to protect their forests
abstract_zh: 热带森林，尤其是对全球生物多样性保护和碳储存具有重要意义的原始热带森林，正日益集中于相对较为富裕的发展中国家。这为这些国家利用国内资金发挥更大作用创造了机会，既可以（i）弥补热带森林保护的资金缺口，也可以（ii）为与减少森林砍伐和森林退化所致温室气体排放相关的国际支付所配套的补充性保护行动提供资金。

title: Does development reduce fatalities from natural disasters? New evidence for floods
abstract: We analyze the impact of development on flood fatalities using a new data set of 2,171 large floods in 92 countries between 1985 and 2008. Our results challenge the conventional wisdom that development results in fewer fatalities during natural disasters. Results indicating that higher income and better governance reduce fatalities during flood events do not hold up when unobserved country heterogeneity and within-country correlation of standard errors are taken into account. We find that income does have a significant, indirect effect on flood fatalities by affecting flood frequency and flood magnitude, but this effect is nonmonotonic, with net reductions in fatalities occurring only in lower income countries. We find little evidence that improved governance affects flood fatalities either directly or indirectly.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个涵盖1985年至2008年间92个国家2,171起大洪水的新数据集，分析了发展对洪涝死亡人数的影响。我们的结果挑战了“发展可减少自然灾害死亡人数”这一传统观点。收入较高和治理较好能减少洪水事件死亡人数的结论，在考虑了未观测到的国家异质性以及国家内部标准误的相关性之后便不再成立。我们发现，收入通过影响洪水频率和洪水规模，对洪涝死亡人数确有显著的间接影响，但这种影响是非单调的：只有在低收入国家，死亡人数才会出现净减少。我们几乎没有发现证据表明治理改善会直接或间接影响洪涝死亡人数。

Climate change, the monsoon, and rice yield in India

abstract:
A recent study by Feng et al. [Feng S, Krueger A, Oppenheimer M (2010)
Proc Natl Acad Sci USA
107:14257–14262] in PNAS reported statistical evidence of a weather-driven causal effect of crop yields on human migration from Mexico to the United States. We show that this conclusion is based on a different statistical model than the one stated in the paper. When we correct for this mistake, there is no evidence of a causal link.
abstract_zh: Feng等人（Feng S, Krueger A, Oppenheimer M，2010，Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 107:14257–14262）近期发表于PNAS的一项研究，报告了天气驱动的作物产量对墨西哥向美国移民具有因果效应的统计证据。我们表明，该结论基于一个与论文所述模型不同的统计模型。当我们纠正这一错误后，并未发现存在因果联系的证据。

title: Costs and benefits of neurosurgical intervention for infant hydrocephalus in sub-Saharan Africa

Governance and Timber Harvests
Microeconomic analysis of innovative environmental programs in developing countries
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Environmental management programs that attempt to cope with institutional weaknesses in developing countries by being less reliant on governments’ formal regulatory apparatus are becoming increasingly common. Three leading examples of such innovative programs are (1) public disclosure and voluntary programs to address industrial pollution; (2) programs that inform households about environmental health risks; and (3) payments for environmental services. Although (1) and (2) have reduced emissions of industrial pollutants and household exposure to environmental health risks in some cases, the reductions are small relative to the size of the problems. Conservation benefits from (3) have been similarly small so far. Evidence on the effectiveness of these programs is limited, both because the programs are relatively new and because there has been limited use of rigorous impact evaluation methods. Despite this weak performance record, continued experimentation with innovative programs appears to be warranted, especially if the opportunity cost is not too high in terms of redirecting resources away from formal environmental management programs and if rigorous impact evaluations are built in to determine whether and why innovative programs have worked. Future research needs to pay attention to the great heterogeneity among developing countries (i.e., successful implementation in one country is no guarantee of success elsewhere), and to the relationship of innovative programs to formal environmental management programs.
abstract_zh: 在制度薄弱的发展中国家，越来越多的环境管理项目试图减少对政府正式监管体系的依赖，这类创新型项目正日益普遍。三个主要的范例是：（1）针对工业污染的信息公开与自愿计划；（2）告知家庭环境健康风险的项目；（3）环境服务付费。尽管（1）和（2）在某些情况下已降低了工业污染物排放和家庭对环境健康风险的暴露，但相对于问题的规模而言，这些降幅很小。（3）带来的保护效益迄今同样有限。关于这些项目有效性的证据有限，原因在于这些项目相对较新，且严谨的影响评估方法使用不足。尽管其表现记录较弱，继续尝试创新型项目似乎仍是合理的，特别是当其机会成本不会过高（即不会将资源从正式的环境管理项目中转移出去），并且在项目中内置了严格的影响评估，以判定创新型项目是否有效以及原因何在。未来研究需要关注发展中国家之间的巨大异质性（即一国的成功实施并不保证在其他国家也能成功），以及创新型项目与正式环境管理项目之间的关系。

title: Rice yields in tropical/subtropical Asia exhibit large but opposing sensitivities to minimum and maximum temperatures
abstract: Data from farmer-managed fields have not been used previously to disentangle the impacts of daily minimum and maximum temperatures and solar radiation on rice yields in tropical/subtropical Asia. We used a multiple regression model to analyze data from 227 intensively managed irrigated rice farms in six important rice-producing countries. The farm-level detail, observed over multiple growing seasons, enabled us to construct farm-specific weather variables, control for unobserved factors that either were unique to each farm but did not vary over time or were common to all farms at a given site but varied by season and year, and obtain more precise estimates by including farm- and site-specific economic variables. Temperature and radiation had statistically significant impacts during both the vegetative and ripening phases of the rice plant. Higher minimum temperature reduced yield, whereas higher maximum temperature raised it; radiation impact varied by growth phase. Combined, these effects imply that yield at most sites would have grown more rapidly during the high-yielding season but less rapidly during the low-yielding season if observed temperature and radiation trends at the end of the 20th century had not occurred, with temperature trends being more influential. Looking ahead, they imply a net negative impact on yield from moderate warming in coming decades. Beyond that, the impact would likely become more negative, because prior research indicates that the impact of maximum temperature becomes negative at higher levels. Diurnal temperature variation must be considered when investigating the impacts of climate change on irrigated rice in Asia.
abstract_zh: 此前从未有研究利用农户管理田块的数据，来厘清日最低温、日最高温和太阳辐射对热带及亚热带亚洲水稻产量的不同影响。我们使用多元回归模型，分析了六个主要水稻生产国227个集约化管理灌溉稻田的数据。这些农场层面的详细信息，来自多个生长季的观测，使我们能够构造农场特定的天气变量，控制那些仅为各农场独有但不随时间变化的不可观测因素，或在某一地点所有农场共有但随季节和年份变化的不可观测因素，并通过纳入农场和地点特定的经济变量获得更精确的估计。气温和辐射在水稻植株的营养生长期和灌浆成熟期均产生了统计上显著的影响。较高的最低气温降低产量，而较高的最高气温则提高产量；辐射的影响因生长阶段而异。综合来看，这些效应意味着：若20世纪末观测到的气温和辐射趋势未曾发生，大多数地点的产量在高产季节会增长得更快，而在低产季节则增长得更慢，其中气温趋势的影响更大。展望未来，这些效应意味着未来几十年中等程度的变暖将对产量产生净负面影响。此后，影响可能会变得更为负面，因为已有研究表明，最高气温达到较高水平时，其影响将转为负值。在研究气候变化对亚洲灌溉水稻的影响时，必须考虑昼夜温差。

title: Mangroves protected villages and reduced death toll during Indian super cyclone

Integrated model shows that atmospheric brown clouds and greenhouse gases have reduced rice harvests in India
abstract: Previous studies have found that atmospheric brown clouds partially offset the warming effects of greenhouse gases. This finding suggests a tradeoff between the impacts of reducing emissions of aerosols and greenhouse gases. Results from a statistical model of historical rice harvests in India, coupled with regional climate scenarios from a parallel climate model, indicate that joint reductions in brown clouds and greenhouse gases would in fact have complementary, positive impacts on harvests. The results also imply that adverse climate changes due to brown clouds and greenhouse gases contributed to the slowdown in harvest growth that occurred during the past two decades.
abstract_zh: 以往研究发现，大气棕色云层会部分抵消温室气体的增温效应。这一发现意味着减少气溶胶排放与减少温室气体排放的影响之间存在权衡。将印度历史稻谷产量的统计模型，与一个并行气候模式给出的区域气候情景相结合，结果表明，同时减少棕色云层和温室气体，实际上会对稻谷产量产生互补性的正面影响。结果还表明，棕色云层和温室气体导致的不利气候变化，是过去二十年稻谷产量增长放缓的原因之一。

title: Genuine savings: Leading indicator of sustainable development?
abstract: The World Bank recently began publishing estimates of countries’ “genuine savings”: a comprehensive measure of net investment across all forms of capital (natural and human as well as produced). This article presents the first empirical investigation of the consistency of the Bank’s estimates with the hypothesis that net investment should equal the difference between a country’s average future consumption and its current consumption. Results show that the Bank’s estimates are consistent only with weak versions of this hypothesis and then only for developing countries. Moreover, a simple autoregressive‐integrated‐moving‐average (ARIMA) model outperforms any net investment measure, comprehensive or conventional, as a predictor of the difference between current and future consumption. In sum, the Bank’s net investment estimates tend to move in the same direction as the difference between current and average future consumption in developing countries, but they have little value for predicting the magnitude of this difference.
abstract_zh: 世界银行近期开始公布各国的“真实储蓄”（genuine savings）估计数：这是一项涵盖所有形式资本（自然资本、人力资本以及生产性资本）的净投资综合衡量指标。本文首次对世界银行的估计是否与以下假设相一致进行了实证检验：净投资应等于一国未来平均消费与当前消费之差。结果表明，世界银行的估计仅与该假设的弱版本相一致，而且仅适用于发展中国家。此外，一个简单的自回归积分移动平均（ARIMA）模型，作为当前消费与未来消费之差的预测指标，其表现优于任何净投资指标（无论是综合性的还是传统的）。总之，在发展中国家，世界银行的净投资估计往往与当前消费和未来平均消费之差的变动方向一致，但在预测这一差距的大小方面价值有限。

title: Public environmental expenditures in Indonesia
abstract: The economic justification for public expenditure is especially strong in the case of environmental management. Yet expenditures on environmental management have received little attention in public expenditure reviews by the World Bank and other international development organisations. An initial analysis of environmental expenditures in the Indonesian government budget between FY1994/95 and FY1998/99 yields four basic findings. First, most spending in the nominal environmental sector, sector 10 (Environment and Spatial Planning), is on non-environmental activities, and much environmental expenditure occurs in other budget sectors. Second, environmental expenditures fell sharply in real terms during the economic crisis, to levels far below those in FY94/95. Third, they also fell sharply relative to the budget and to GDP. Finally, environmental expenditures declined more in Indonesia during the economic crisis than in Malaysia, Thailand and Korea, relative to both the budget and GDP.
abstract_zh: 在环境管理领域，公共支出的经济合理性尤为充分。然而，世界银行和其他国际发展机构在公共支出评估中很少关注环境管理支出。对印度尼西亚政府1994/95至1998/99财年预算中环境支出的初步分析得出四项基本发现。第一，名义上的环境部门（第10部门，环境与空间规划）的大部分支出用于非环境活动，且大量环境支出发生在其他预算部门。第二，在经济危机期间，环境支出以实际值计算大幅下降，降至远低于1994/95财年的水平。第三，相对于预算和GDP，环境支出也大幅下降。最后，在经济危机期间，无论相对于预算还是GDP，印尼环境支出的降幅都大于马来西亚、泰国和韩国。

title: Timber booms and institutional breakdown in Southeast Asia
How important is improved water infrastructure to microenterprises? Evidence from Uganda
Promoting better logging practices in tropical forests: A simulation analysis of alternative regulations
abstract: Standard recommendations for im- proving logging practices in tropical forests in- clude lengthening concession agreements, making concessions renewable, and requiring conces- sionaires to deposit performance bonds. In this paper we investigate the likely effectiveness of these recommendations by using a simulation model of a Malaysian rainforest. We focus on two classes of decisions faced by loggers: which log- ging technology to adopt and whether or not to comply with prescribed diameter cutting limits. We predict the impact of alternative regulations on these decisions and on the resulting economic and environmental outcomes. Renewability condi- tions and performance bonds emerge as potent in- struments for improving logger behavior. (JEL Q23)
abstract_zh: 改善热带森林伐木实践的标准建议包括：延长特许经营协议期限、使特许经营权可续期，以及要求特许经营者缴纳履约保证金。本文利用马来西亚雨林的模拟模型，考察了这些建议可能的有效性。我们聚焦伐木者面临的两类决策：采用何种伐木技术，以及是否遵守规定的胸径采伐限制。我们预测了各种替代法规对这些决策及由此产生的经济和环境结果的影响。可续期条件与履约保证金被证明是改善伐木者行为的有力工具。（JEL Q23）

title: Net accumulation of timber resources
The economics of air pollution health risks in Russia: A case study of Volgograd
Resource depletion and economic sustainability in Malaysia
abstract: Countries richly endowed with natural resources have, on average, developed less rapidly than countries that are poor in natural resources. One possible explanation for this phenomenon is that the level of investment in reproducible capital has been insufficient to offset the depletion of natural capital. The empirical significance of this explanation can be investigated by analysing modified measures of net investment and net domestic product. Estimation of these measures involves calculating the economic depreciation of natural resources, a task that has been problematic in previous studies. Malaysia provides an ideal case for such empirical investigations, as it is one of the world's most resource-rich countries yet also has one of the world's fastest-growing economies, consists of three subnational regions that differ significantly in terms of economic structure, and has sufficient data for estimating conceptually correct measures of natural resource depreciation. Results of the analysis indicate that Malaysia has developed sustainably, despite substantial resource depletion. This is not the case in two of the regions, however, where trends in both net investment and net domestic product indicate that current consumption levels cannot be sustained. Nevertheless, the regional differences in sustainability might be consistent with optimal national use of the rents generated by exploitation of the country's natural resources.
abstract_zh: 资源禀赋丰富的国家平均而言，其发展速度往往低于资源匮乏的国家。一种可能的解释是，可再生资本的投资水平不足以抵消自然资本的消耗。这一解释的经验意义可以通过分析修正后的净投资和净国内产品指标来检验。这些指标的估算需要计算自然资源的经济折旧，而这一任务在以往研究中一直存在困难。马来西亚为此类实证研究提供了理想案例：它是世界上资源最丰富的国家之一，同时也拥有世界上增长最快的经济体之一，由三个在经济结构上差异显著的次国家区域构成，并且拥有足够的数据，可用于估算概念上正确的自然资源折旧指标。分析结果表明，尽管存在大量资源消耗，马来西亚的发展仍是可持续的。然而，在其中两个地区情况则并非如此，净投资和净国内产品的趋势都表明，当前的消费水平无法维持。不过，地区间可持续性的差异，可能与国家层面对资源开采所产生租金的最优使用相一致。

title: Testing for environmental Kuznets curves within a developing country
abstract: Previous studies of the association between pollution and income have tended to analyse cross-sectional or panel data for a sample of developing and developed countries. This paper presents an analysis for a single country, Malaysia. This south-east Asian country has more, and probably better, data on environmental quality than perhaps any other developing country. I find that pollution–income relationships from the cross-country studies fail to predict accurately trends in air and water pollution in Malaysia. In particular, none of six pollution-income relationships estimated using a panel data set for Malaysian states has the hypothesized 'environmental Kuznets curve' form. Although these results are inconsistent with the predictions of the cross-country relationships, they make sense in the Malaysian context. Perhaps most important, their interpretation confirms the importance of policy decisions in determining environmental outcomes.
abstract_zh: 以往关于污染与收入之间关系的研究，往往分析发展中国家与发达国家样本的横截面数据或面板数据。本文则对单一国家马来西亚进行了分析。这个东南亚国家拥有的环境质量数据可能比其他任何发展中国家都更多，质量也可能更好。我发现，跨国研究中的污染—收入关系无法准确预测马来西亚空气和水污染的趋势。尤其是，利用马来西亚各州面板数据估计的六个污染—收入关系中，没有一个呈现假设中的“环境库兹涅茨曲线”形态。尽管这些结果与跨国关系的预测不一致，但它们在马来西亚的背景下是合理的。也许最重要的是，对这些结果的解读证实了政策决策在决定环境结果方面的重要作用。

title: Efficient multiple-use forestry may require land-use specialization
abstract: Considered at the landscape scale, economically efficient multiple use of forests may require land-use specialization. If managers attempt to satisfy legitimate multiple-use demands from society by managing all lands for all outputs, both commodity and amenity values of the forest may be inappropriately supplied, and management inputs may be inefficiently deployed. These results run counter to some of the prescriptions called "new forestry."
abstract_zh: 从景观尺度来看，经济上有效率的森林多用途利用可能需要土地利用的专业化。如果管理者试图通过在所有土地上管理所有产出，来满足社会合理的多用途需求，那么森林的商品价值和舒适价值都可能供给不当，管理投入也可能部署低效。这些结果与一些“新林业”（new forestry）的主张背道而驰。

title: Rent capture and the feasibility of tropical forest management
abstract: Hyde, Amacher, and Magrath (1996) imply that deforestation and timber rents (logging revenue minus logging costs other than timber fees) are not subjects that justify policymakers' attention, arguing that market responses limit the scope of deforestation ...
abstract_zh: Hyde、Amacher和Magrath（1996）暗示，森林砍伐和木材租金（伐木收入减去木材费用以外的伐木成本）并不是值得政策制定者关注的问题，他们认为市场反应限制了森林砍伐的范围……
